messages:
Ava (PM): quick sync — customer X pushed back on our rerank contract. they need predictable scoring across queries and a clear top_k SLA. can we sketch options?
Ben (Eng): got it. can you summarize the asks? top_k range? latency targets?
Ava (PM): top asks: 1) deterministic top_k behavior (defaults + max cap), 2) an option for "normalized" scores so downstream thresholds are stable, 3) defined truncation rules for long candidates/queries, 4) input shape options (pairwise vs batch).
Carla (ML): normalization is tricky: raw model logits vary by query length & prompt. we can offer two modes: "raw" (logits / score) and "normalized" (softmax across candidates) or "rescaled" (min-max per response). each has tradeoffs for ranking calibration.
Erin (Eng-API): API surfaces we could expose: `score_mode` = ["raw","softmax","minmax"]; `top_k` int; `max_candidates` limit; `truncate_policy` = ["candidate_trunc","query_trunc","reject"]; examples:

```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "...",
  "candidates": ["a","b","c"],
  "top_k": 10,
  "score_mode": "softmax",
  "truncate_policy": "candidate_trunc"
}
```

Diego (Product Ops): customers want guarantees: if they ask top_k=50 we should clarify latency/cost. default should be conservative (top_k=5) to avoid surprises. also need a clear error when candidate count < top_k.
Ben (Eng): agree default top_k=5, max_top_k=200 (configurable per plan). we should return `returned_top_k` in response so callers know. also add `estimated_cost_tokens` meta to help customers.
Carla (ML): on normalization: softmax makes scores comparable across candidates in the same query but not across queries. for cross-query thresholds, we should provide a calibrated score field: `calibrated_score` produced by a tiny post-hoc regression model trained on eval set. small complexity but gives stability.
Frank (Infra): note: calibrated scoring will add an extra microservice and latency ~5-12ms. okay for hosted, but Dedicated / Private customers may want to opt out. we should make it an opt-in flag `enable_calibration`.
Ava (PM): product ask: default experience should be predictable and simple. proposal: launch v1 with: default top_k=5, optional top_k up to 100, score_mode default="raw" but `softmax` available, and a separate opt-in `calibrated_score` beta. truncation behavior: candidate_trunc by default with head-only truncation and `...` marker.
Erin (Eng-API): need to be explicit about how truncation affects scoring. if candidate truncated we should expose `truncation_applied: true` and maybe `truncation_reason`. also, if query truncated, we should reject unless `truncate_policy=auto`.
Ben (Eng): edge-case: extremely long candidate lists (streaming). support streaming candidate scoring? that'll change routing & batching. we should accept streaming payloads but limit max in single request.
Carla (ML): scoring normalization across streamed candidates—softmax over entire stream isn't feasible. we can provide incremental scores + a `finalize` call to normalize at end; or recommend client-side sampling. both are more advanced; maybe v2.
Diego (Product Ops): launch criteria checklist idea: - API contract doc + examples - clear default limits - billing impact doc - migration guide for customers using old ranking endpoints - telemetry for truncated requests
Ava (PM): ok can we map owners & ETA? v1 (conservative) in 6 wks, v1 feature list: defaults + score_mode + truncate flags + clear error messages + telemetry.
Ben (Eng): I'll take API impl + server-side defaults. ETA 6w.
Erin (Eng-API): I'll own docs + SDK changes + migration notes.
Carla (ML): I'll prototype `calibrated_score` and eval sample; aim for internal beta in 8w.
Frank (Infra): I'll size infra for streaming/large-topk and add quota guardrails. need product to set default max_top_k per plan.
Ava (PM): decision summary: launch v1 conservative surface: default top_k=5, max_top_k=100 for hosted (plan-configurable), score_mode options [raw,softmax,minmax], `calibrated_score` opt-in beta, `truncate_policy` documented with `truncation_applied` flag.
Diego (Product Ops): note follow-ups: pricing note for >5 returned items, SLA language for top_k latencies, and a warning banner for private deployments (calibration opt-out).
Ben (Eng): one more: response shape should include `scores` array aligned to returned candidates, `score_mode` echo, `returned_top_k`, and `truncation_applied` per candidate.
Ava (PM): perfect. I'll draft the spec doc and set a review next Tue 10am. ping @Carla @Erin for inputs. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: spec-review /rerank-surface — Tue 10:00
Carla (ML): ack, will attach calibration eval notes before review.
Erin (Eng-API): will add example SDK snippets and an upgrade guide.
Frank (Infra): starting infra sizing doc, will flag any blockers by EOW.
Ava (PM): thanks everyone — leaving TODOs in linear.
